# Module M-04: Check today's orders were confirmed

## Lesson

You do this after the morning's orders are in. When it works, every order shows as confirmed on the day it was sent, with its lines. [SC-04]

## Exercise

In the test environment, with its test data:

1. Open the confirmation view. [SC-04 step 1]
2. Find each of today's orders and check it shows as confirmed. [SC-04 step 2]

## Check question

What do you do when it goes wrong?

## Answer

An order not confirmed has a line on the exceptions list; ask the order coordinator. [map/future.md item 3]
